title: BrowserProviderJobCreateResult
description: browser-provider.job-create-result@1 (PLANNED; plan T14 R4a, ADR-034): an external managed-browser provider's answer to OpenVibe.Run's job POST (browser-provider.job-create-request@1): 201 { job, created: true } when it accepted a new job, 200 { job, created: false } for an idempotent repeat of an id it already holds (the first job's state, nothing started twice). JOB is browser-provider.job-state@1 and Run validates it before adopting any of it. A refused POST answers a problem instead (4xx; 5xx is retried by Run on its next tick), never this contract. For the later calls, GET <provider>/jobs/:id answers browser-provider.job-state@1 and POST <provider>/jobs/:id/cancel answers it too; a 404 on either means the provider does not know the job.

created.description: True when this POST created the job (201); false for an idempotent repeat (200).
